cohort: The study included any patient undergoing a surgical procedure in the Obstetrics and Gynecology unit of Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar from January 2017 to December 2018.
finding: The frequency of iatrogenic urological tract injury was 0.036% in obstetrics emergency and elective procedures and 0.45% in gynecological procedures, with the urinary bladder being the most frequently damaged viscus in obstetrics.
